name: ask
description: A side chat in a pane that reads the main chat, scrolls and draws: /ask a question, /draw a diagram. Nothing goes back to the main chat unless you send it. Answers are Mermaid drawn as box art in the terminal and as SVG in the desktop app.

liveModel.title: Model before the first turn
liveModel.description: Before the session's first turn there is no main chat to fork, so a question is answered by a plain completion over the transcript with this model. Forks always use the session's model.

keep.title: Questions kept in the pane
keep.description: How many exchanges the pane keeps; older ones scroll away for good.
